appraisal_events.evidence: elle ajoutait tant de timidité... tant de tendresse... que Saint-Loup ne put pas ne pas apercevoir en lui-même comme la possibilité d'un attendrissement, c'est-à-dire un obstacle à passer la soirée avec son amie. Aussi se mit-il en colère: — C'est regrettable, mais gentil ou non, c'est ainsi.
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite his mother's careful, timid, tender plea for the one day she could have had him, Robert reacts with anger and a curt refusal, guarding himself against tenderness that would interfere with his evening with his mistress.

status_effects.explanation: Her gentle, self-effacing appeal for her son's company is met with anger and cold refusal, leaving her rebuffed after having taken great care not to burden or provoke him.
The narrator frames Robert's anger as a defensive reflex against his own softening, choosing his mistress's evening over any tenderness toward his mother, which casts him unfavorably.
